profile.name: HARSHVARDHAN PATIL
profile.tagline: I build things that live on the internet.
profile.about: I enjoy building software, exploring new technologies, and constantly learning through experiments. Alongside preparing for NEET, I spend my free time coding, diving into cyberworld, and creating fun projects like this portfolio. I also direct award-winning short films and develop games with my team. Outside of tech, I'm passionate about photography, trekking, art, and nature. I'm always excited to learn, create, and challenge myself.
